This mod adds the complete Sequence 9–0 Paragon, Red Priest, and Black Emperor Pathways.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Pathway abilities, potion projects, Pathway Holders, runaway workshops, uncontrolled monsters, Sealed Artifacts, and the three True God Churches form the core experience. Use the Pathway button at the upper left to review your Sequence, digestion, abilities, and next advancement.
Each human player chooses exactly one Pathway, and that choice is permanent.

Paragon focuses on science, construction, Great Works, and broad yields. Red Priest grows through war, pillaging, schemes, and conquest. Black Emperor manipulates Gold, policies, Loyalty, and hostile order.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each Pathway has its own Sequences, abilities, digestion conditions, and projects while sharing the Holder, church, and artifact foundations.
Your unique Beyonder unit drives many abilities and digestion conditions.

The Holder's baseline Combat Strength follows the base-game melee technology chain and it has two independent, sequential promotion branches.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]After death, the Holder preserves experience, veteran name, and dedicated promotions, then revives after 5 player turns. A player can never have more than one Holder.
Begin at Sequence 9 and advance in order to Sequence 0, retaining most earlier abilities.

The Pathway button displays your current Sequence, name, and digestion. Open it for current and inherited abilities, digestion conditions, and the next potion or ritual.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sequence 0 is the endpoint and needs no further digestion. After the final project, open the Pathway entry to play its dedicated ascension ceremony.
Act according to your Sequence and usually collect 6 digestion points before advancing.

Most Sequences can gain at most 2 digestion points per player turn, and advancement resets current digestion. A few rules, such as Black Emperor Sequence 9, explicitly differ.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sources vary by Pathway and Sequence across research, construction, combat, diplomacy, trade, policies, and Loyalty. The live Pathway details are authoritative.
After digestion, complete the matching city project to advance and gain the next ability.

Every Sequence has a dedicated potion or ritual project. Projects remain locked until digestion, technology, and any other prerequisites are satisfied.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Some middle and high Sequences require Industrialization. Sequence 1 uses a final ritual: a True God Church grants normal cost; otherwise an unconsecrated ritual with double Production is available.
Church Beliefs and the Three True Gods
Personal religious beliefs aid digestion, while three cityless Churches on the City-States screen provide envoy bonuses, Oracle quests, and divine blessings.

The Establish Church pantheon grants 1 current-Sequence digestion point every 3 turns. Establish a True God Church grants 1 each turn and enables the normal-cost Sequence 0 project; without it, the double-Production unconsecrated ritual remains available.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The City-States screen always includes the Fool, Evernight Goddess, and Lord of Storms Churches. They have no city, army, diplomacy, suzerain, or city-state slot. Spend ordinary unassigned envoys separately for each Church's permanent 1／3／6-envoy effects.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Reaching 6／10／15 envoys sequentially starts a one-time Oracle quest. Its target bears that Church's emblem and can be located from the UI. Resolve your own target for +1 envoy and a tier-matched Sealed Artifact chance; otherwise gain a full blessing. If another power resolves it, gain a half blessing. Full and half blessings last 10／12／15 player turns by tier, and a right-side Church notification states the actual reward.
AI major civilizations belong to the Demoness, Hanged Man, or Chained Church and suppress targets with their Evil God's power.

Every AI major civilization permanently belongs to the Demoness, Hanged Man, or Chained Church. With at least three AIs, all three Evil God Churches are prioritized. Each Church independently shares tier 1／2／3 and advances with its members' technological progress.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Demoness Church suppresses the score leader. The Hanged Man and Chained Churches suppress humans on a formal Pathway during war. Actual effect strength varies with the difference between the Church tier and the target's Pathway tier, and only the current tier's skill applies.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]After meeting an AI, view its Church, shared tier, and current skill on the diplomatic intelligence screen. A right-side notification identifies the Church and skill when an Evil God effect begins or ends.
A Barbarian Camp has a 50% chance to become a runaway workshop; after a workshop's normal spawn, it has a 30% chance to produce the matching monster tier.

Ordinary Barbarian Camps use the same spawn intensity in every era. The camp target cap, visibility rule, city/camp spacing, and legal-plot rules follow the base game.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A workshop permanently rolls a Pathway and tier 2／1／0 and is guarded by the matching immobile Sequencer. Tier odds follow the world era, and more dangerous low-numbered workshops duplicate additional ordinary Barbarian units. Only a human major civilization that actually clears the camp receives its Sealed Artifact reward.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]After each confirmed ordinary workshop spawn, every tier has a 30% chance to create a low／mid／high-tier uncontrolled monster, subject to one live monster per workshop, a 10-world-turn cooldown, the map cap, and a legal spawn tile. A monster uses the strongest ordinary Barbarian melee model unlocked at birth, gains +15 Combat Strength from Frenzy, heals 10 each Barbarian turn, and moves only across unowned land.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Killing one normally grants 500 Gold times the current world-era number. If the killer personally has the matching Church Oracle quest, the Church reward replaces that ordinary Gold reward.
All 21 artifacts are globally unique and combine exceptional power with meaningful drawbacks.

Clearing a workshop awards one unclaimed artifact from its Pathway and tier pool.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Open Sealed Artifacts from the upper left. Drag inventory items into nine equipment slots; drag them back or right-click to unequip. This independent system never enters the base-game Great Work slots, overview, or gallery.
Paragon artifacts enhance knowledge, production, Great Works, and development by sacrificing other yields.
Icons are ordered by tier 2, tier 1, then tier 0. The live artifact screen and current game values remain authoritative.
Red Priest artifacts favor pillaging, war, and conquest, often at a severe peacetime or upkeep cost.
Icons are ordered by tier 2, tier 1, then tier 0. Effects may settle on war, kills, or turns; completed one-shot results are not rolled back when unequipped.
Black Emperor artifacts distort wealth, order, and Loyalty in exchanges of extreme benefit and cost.

At every player turn, synchronized Gameplay reissues persistent artifact effects from the current equipment layout for that turn only. Equipping or removing recalculates immediately and is authoritative by the next player turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Completed one-shot or turn events are not retroactive, and repeated equip/unequip cannot permanently stack persistent effects.

This is a cooperative world crisis with a deadline: purify the outbreak, ascend to a true god, and defeat the Outer God after descent.

This book covers only rules added or changed by Redemption Mode. Pathway choice, ordinary advancement, common Sealed Artifact controls, and Church rules not overridden here remain identical to regular mode and are not repeated.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Redemption Mode adds four sealed cities, five escalating crisis periods, global Purification, major-civilization cooperation, Church guardians, Redemption-specific Red Priest rules, player true gods, the Outer God finale, and Redemption Victory.
The world creates the central descent city and three holy cities for the Fool, Night, and Storm Churches.

Independent factions hold the four cities, whose fixed regions form the Redemption battlefield. Their Loyalty is maintained at 100; they do not use ordinary city-state Envoys and are not cities the player must conquer.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]After final descent, the Outer God and its minions exclude these four cities when choosing cities to destroy. Every other city, including a Capital, lacks this protection. Church guardians appear around the three holy cities, while the central city marks the final descent area.
The deadline is divided proportionally into five periods, with rising workshop, Sequencer, and monster pressure.

Redemption Mode raises the Barbarian Camp target to six times the number of surviving major civilizations and can add up to 10 legal camps per world turn while below target. Workshop chances by period are 80／85／90／95／100%, and newly born uncontrolled units gain +0／10／20／30／40 Combat Strength.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Low／mid／high workshop-center Sequencers additionally gain +15／+25／+35 Combat Strength. Roaming monster chances are 60／75／85／95／100%, active attempts are 6／8／10／12／15, and global live caps are 40／50／60／70／80. Each independently locks onto the nearest ordinary AI or city-state city on its continent. All human targets are ignored while another faction remains; that protection ends only when the map contains only humans and the Redemption seal／three Churches.
Major civilizations form a permanent coalition by default, while Saints and Angels help clear uncontrolled threats.

The advanced option “Permanent Major-Civilization Alliance” is enabled by default and prevents all surviving majors from declaring war on one another. Disabling it preserves human war freedom, while AIs still prefer peace and are discouraged from initiating wars.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each Church maintains up to three Saints and one Angel. Saints have base Combat Strength 90 and Movement 3; Angels have base Combat Strength 130 and Movement 4. They synchronously advance up to their Movement each turn to pursue and clear uncontrolled monsters first, then roaming ordinary Barbarians that are not defending camps. They never attack or clear camps and workshops, never deliberately attack normal civilizations, and cannot capture cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Evil God Churches no longer suppress players here; instead they grant cumulative stage support to member AIs. Ordinary AIs receive +50% military-unit Production, -30% Gold purchase cost for military units, and 100 land／naval／air military decision weight, while each AI major retains at most 15 combat units.
All normal factions build one global Purification score; a higher score weakens the final Outer God.

Killing low／mid／high uncontrolled units contributes 1／2／4 Purification; clearing their matching workshop tiers contributes 4／8／12. Humans, normal AIs, city-states, and Church guardians can all contribute, and the top bar shows the global total and contribution ranking.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Outer God tier boundaries are 500／1000／1500／2000. The bar displays up to 3000, but the raw score can continue to rise. The tier locks permanently at final descent; the bar then disappears and later Purification cannot change that game's Outer God strength.
Paragon and Black Emperor retain regular growth; Red Priest abilities and digestion are rebuilt for the high-density world crisis.

Red Priest Redemption abilities progress through: Sequence 9 Movement, Sight, and attacks against Barbarians or wounded targets; Sequence 8 +40 while fortified and full healing; Sequence 7 six-tile Arson for 70 damage with a five-turn cooldown; Sequence 6 -50% military Gold purchases and -2 maintenance per unit; Sequence 5 healing after friendly kills; Sequence 4 +30 Combat Strength and +3 Movement to all units; Sequence 3 permanent +100% Production in all cities; Sequence 2 another +30 and +3 to all units; Sequence 1 one extra attack per turn; and Sequence 0 cities operating at ten times normal Production.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Its digestion sources also shift to experience, uncontrolled targets, Arson, military production and purchases, kills, and second attacks. The live Pathway details remain authoritative for exact conditions.
War God's Relic and Player True Gods
Reach 6 Envoys in all three Churches and complete War God's Relic to prepare Divine Legion for a Sequence 0 true god.

Redemption Mode replaces the three separate 6-Envoy Oracles with one shared milestone: when the Fool, Night, and Storm Churches each reach 6 Envoys, the one-time War God's Relic project becomes available. The later 10- and 15-Envoy Oracles remain.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Completing the project grants Divine Legion. A Sequence 0 player of any Pathway may sacrifice a friendly non-divine combat unit; each sacrifice permanently adds one tenth of that unit's current live Combat Strength, rounded down. Eligibility does not depend on land, naval, or air FormationClass, so modded heroes and special units qualify whenever their live Combat Strength is above 0. Divine units cannot be sacrificed.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Final descent creates the matching Pathway true god with 550 base Combat Strength plus the accumulated sacrifice bonus. Its first death is followed by revival after 5 turns; a second death is permanent. It gains +30 Movement when live Combat Strength is strictly above 1000 and no bonus at 1000 or below.
At the deadline, Purification locks and the Church gods, player gods, and Outer God enter the central battlefield.

The deadline scales by game speed: Online 75, Quick 101, Standard 150, Epic 225, and Marathon 450 world turns. At Purification 0–499／500–999／1000–1499／1500–1999／2000–2999／3000+, the Outer God locks to Combat Strength 999／888／777／666／555／444. The 3000 tier further reduces Combat Strength only; its other highest-Purification parameters remain unchanged.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Outer God has Movement 6 and first attacks the nearest surviving Church god. Once all three are dead, it destroys the nearest unprotected city. Minions directly pursue and destroy the nearest unprotected city. Each Church god can revive once after five turns; the Outer God has exactly two lives.
Exhaust both Outer God lives through real combat and land the final defeat to earn the separate Redemption Victory.

Combat between gods uses the original strength-difference damage curve with current Combat Strength; there is no direct execution that ignores strength. After the first valid defeat, the Outer God enters its second life. Redemption Victory is granted only when its final life is validly defeated in combat.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Script removal, engine cleanup, or disappearance for an unknown reason does not trigger victory; the Outer God is restored at its current life stage. Redemption Victory has its own victory type, progress, and end screen and does not require conquering other civilizations.
